name: How do I decide which home improvements to make before listing?

mainEntity.name: How do I decide which home improvements to make before listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decide on home improvements by considering buyer expectations, potential return on investment, and your budget. Focus on repairs that address deficiencies or enhance broad appeal rather than highly personalized renovations. A pre-listing inspection can highlight critical issues. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can provide guidance based on current market trends in areas like Aventura, Boca Raton, or Coral Gables, helping you prioritize improvements that attract buyers effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize improvements that address deficiencies or broad appeal, considering buyer expectations and budget. A pre-listing inspection can guide your decisions.
